meta.title: The Kendo UI Grid alternative for every framework | AG Grid
meta.description: Looking for a Kendo UI Grid alternative? AG Grid is a JavaScript data grid for React, Angular, Vue and JavaScript with a free MIT-licensed core. Compare features, pricing and licensing.

hero.heading: A Kendo UI Grid alternative
hero.subHeading: Looking for a Kendo UI Grid alternative? AG Grid is one data grid for React, Angular, Vue and plain JavaScript, with a free MIT-licensed Community edition for every framework.

whySwitch.heading: Why teams look for a Kendo UI Grid alternative
reasons: Kendo UI is sold as separate libraries per framework, and only the React version has a free tier.
Row virtualisation, column pinning and server-side data are paid features in KendoReact.
Kendo licences are annual subscriptions per developer.

whyProduct.title: One grid for every framework
whyProduct.body: Official packages for React, Angular and Vue, plus plain JavaScript, with the same grid features in each.

whyProduct.title: Large datasets in the free version
whyProduct.body: Row and column virtualisation are on by default in AG Grid Community, and the Infinite Row Model loads data from the server as users scroll.

whyProduct.title: Analysis built into the grid
whyProduct.body: AG Grid Enterprise adds row grouping, aggregation, pivoting, master/detail, Excel export and integrated charts to the same component.

whyProduct.title: Clear licensing
whyProduct.body: AG Grid Community is MIT licensed. AG Grid Enterprise is a perpetual licence with one year of updates and support.

faq.question: Is there a free alternative to Kendo UI Grid?
faq.answer: Yes. AG Grid Community is free under the MIT licence for React, Angular, Vue and plain JavaScript, including for commercial use.

faq.question: Is Kendo grid free?
faq.answer: Only the React version has a free tier, KendoReact Free, with a reduced Grid feature set. Kendo UI for Angular, Vue and jQuery need a paid licence.

faq.question: Does AG Grid work with Angular?
faq.answer: Yes. AG Grid has official packages for Angular, React and Vue, and can be used with plain JavaScript.

faq.question: How much does an AG Grid licence cost?
faq.answer: AG Grid Community is free. AG Grid Enterprise, and the Enterprise Bundle with AG Charts Enterprise, are paid perpetual licences that include one year of updates and support. See [AG Grid pricing](/license-pricing/) for prices.

proseClaims.claim: Kendo UI Grid is sold as separate libraries for React (KendoReact), Angular, Vue and jQuery; the Kendo UI subscription covers all four.
KendoReact Free includes the Grid with a reduced feature set.
All Kendo UI for Angular components need a trial or commercial licence.
The Kendo UI for Vue Grid needs a commercial or trial licence key.
Kendo UI Core, the free jQuery library, does not include the Grid.
In KendoReact, row virtualisation and server-side data operations are premium.
KendoReact and Kendo UI are sold as annual subscriptions per developer.
